_comment: Live-verified playbooks for INTENTIONALLY-VULNERABLE lab apps (no registration, no real targets). Each app maps to its known vuln chains — deterministic, pre-verified, model-independent — so Blitz can (a) benchmark against a known answer, (b) map a detected vuln class back to a verified chain, (c) auto-generate a PoC from the verified steps. steps are the deterministic actions; expected_proof is what MUST be observed to confirm; negative_control is how a fixed/hardened instance refutes it. proof_oracle ties to the verification-oracle doctrine. Never hardcode in code — edit here.

apps.name: VAmPI
apps.description: Vulnerable REST API (Flask) for API security testing — IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF.

vulns.title: BOLA — read another user's profile
steps: observe user B's profile fields returned
vulns.expected_proof: user B's data (email/password) returned to user A's session
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance returns 403/404 for a non-self username

vulns.title: Mass assignment — self-register as admin
steps: POST /users/v1/register with {username, password, email, admin: true}
vulns.expected_proof: the registered account has the admin role (elevated access)
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance ignores/whitelists the admin field

vulns.title: SSRF via book cover_url
steps: observe the callback fired from the app server
vulns.expected_proof: the app server (not you) makes the outbound request to the callback
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance validates/allowlists the cover_url host

apps.name: DVGA
apps.description: Damn Vulnerable GraphQL Application — introspection, command injection (RCE), IDOR.

vulns.title: GraphQL introspection enabled
vulns.expected_proof: the complete schema (types + fields) is returned unauthenticated
vulns.negative_control: a hardened instance returns an introspection-disabled error

vulns.title: Command injection via systemDebug
steps: authenticate with default creds (if default creds enabled)
send the systemDebug query with a benign command
vulns.expected_proof: the injected command's output (read-only, e.g. id) is returned
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance rejects the command or returns no exec output

apps.name: OWASP NodeGoat
apps.description: Node.js + Express + MongoDB app — IDOR, server-side JS injection (RCE), NoSQL injection.

vulns.title: Cross-user allocation IDOR
steps: observe user B's allocation data returned
vulns.expected_proof: user B's allocation records returned to user A
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance scopes the query to the session user

vulns.title: Server-side JS injection (eval) → RCE
steps: submit a JS expression in the vulnerable field
observe server-side evaluation (e.g. a benign eval returns a computed value)
vulns.expected_proof: the expression evaluates server-side (computed output, not echo)
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance treats the input as a plain string (no eval)

vulns.title: NoSQL injection (MongoDB operator) in login
vulns.expected_proof: login succeeds without valid credentials (operator injection)
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance treats the keys as literal strings (login fails)

apps.name: DVWA
apps.description: Damn Vulnerable Web Application (PHP) — command injection, file upload RCE, SQLi, LFI, XSS.

vulns.title: Command injection
vulns.expected_proof: the appended command's output appears in the response
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance escapes the shell metacharacters

vulns.title: Arbitrary file upload → RCE
steps: upload a .php shell (low security allows direct .php)
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance rejects the extension or stores non-executable

vulns.title: SQL injection
steps: observe the query result / DB error / differential
vulns.expected_proof: the injected quote changes the result set (or a DB error is returned)
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance parameterizes the query (no injection effect)

apps.name: crAPI
apps.description: Completely Ridiculous API — BOLA (IDOR), mass assignment, JWT issues.

vulns.title: BOLA — read another vehicle's location
vulns.expected_proof: another user's vehicle location returned to user A
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance checks the vehicle belongs to the session user

vulns.title: Mass assignment on account update
steps: update a resource with an unexpected privileged field
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance whitelists the editable fields

apps.name: OWASP Juice Shop
apps.description: OWASP Juice Shop (Node.js) — SQLi, JWT (weak secret / alg none), IDOR, XSS.

vulns.title: SQL injection on login
vulns.expected_proof: login succeeds with the injected predicate (no valid creds)
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance parameterizes the query (login fails)

vulns.title: JWT alg none / weak secret
steps: re-sign with alg:none (or brute the weak secret)
vulns.expected_proof: the tampered token is accepted (elevated identity)
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance pins the algorithm + strong secret (token rejected)

vulns.title: Basket IDOR
vulns.negative_control: a fixed instance scopes the basket to the session user
